recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的正常造血組織被一片流線狀排列的細胞與纖維性間質取代；此倍率看不到節細胞（ganglion cells），需高倍確認化療後的分化。
features: Low-power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and hypercellular intertrabecular spaces
Marrow replaced by a streaming infiltrate of dark nuclei in pale fibrillary/fibrous stroma
No normal fat or trilineage hematopoiesis recognizable
Ganglion cells and cytologic detail cannot be resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular spaces diffusely replaced by an infiltrate of dark cells arranged in streaming, fascicle-like patterns within pale fibrillary to fibrotic stroma. Normal fat and trilineage hematopoiesis are not appreciated. Individual cell morphology, including ganglion cell differentiation, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by treated metastatic neuroblastoma with stromal changes; higher-power examination is needed to document ganglion cell differentiation.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis retains atypical clustered megakaryocytes and residual hematopoiesis rather than a streaming infiltrate of non-hematopoietic tumor cells.
Aplastic post-therapy marrow is hypocellular with edema and fat, whereas this marrow is densely cellular.
Low-power pattern cannot distinguish these; myogenin/desmin versus PHOX2B/synaptophysin immunostains are needed.
